name: Четыре колонки
executedPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one extremely simple, polished website Languages section for Globoox, landscape 1536×864. Flat forest-green #2C3B2D background, warm ivory #F4F0E8 text, muted light sage secondary text. Lora-like Cyrillic serif headline, Inter-like supporting text. Realistic compact website spacing, generous side margins, no huge empty lower half. ONLY typography and, when specified, a single subtle hairline. No illustrations, books, cards, badges, pills, flags, icons, ornamental lines, gradients, textures, shadows, buttons, controls, header or footer. Avoid decorative cleverness. This is a quiet supporting section, not a spectacular hero. Required exact copy, each item ONCE: heading “Языки перевода”; current label “Уже доступны” with English, Français, Español, Русский; upcoming label “Скоро” with Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Türkçe, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, العربية, فارسی. Keep all four available names and all nine upcoming names clearly grouped and readable; correct accents/scripts. Available names medium-large, upcoming smaller but readable. Do not add any text or numbering. Heading left, current label below. Four equal typographic columns across width, each carries one large sans-serif current name. No column rules or cards. Upcoming group sits beneath as a single compact left-aligned block: label followed by the nine names wrapping naturally into two evenly spaced rows.

review.method: Visual inspection of actual generated image
observations: Left-aligned heading and status labels; four equal columns with large sans-serif current names; future names in two smaller rows; no rules or cards.
Exact main heading and status labels present.
Four available names and nine upcoming names each appear once in correct status group; accents and scripts visually checked.
Green background, cream text, muted sage labels; all names legible and uncrowded.
No books, illustrations, cards, badges, flags, icons, controls, CTA, header or footer.
caveats: Native generated dimensions retained unchanged; raster proposal, not implemented UI.
